## Learning Delivery Formats
1. Offline Classroom Coaching: Small, focused interactive batches at Hatigaon, Guwahati center equipped with modern audio-visual tools.
2. Home Tutoring in Guwahati: 1-on-1 customized home tuition for Class 11, Class 12, NEET, and JEE students throughout Guwahati.
3. Live Interactive Online Batches: Real-time sessions with interactive whiteboard, live doubt solving, and recorded lectures.

## Courses & Curriculum
- Class 11 Physics (CBSE / AHSEC): Core mechanics, kinematics, Newton's laws of motion, gravitation, thermodynamics, fluids, oscillations, and wave dynamics.
- Class 12 Physics (CBSE / AHSEC): Electrostatics, current electricity, magnetism, electromagnetic induction, AC circuits, optics, dual nature of matter, atomic & nuclear physics, semiconductor electronics.
- NEET Physics Coaching & Dropper Batch: High-yield formulas, rapid mental problem-solving techniques, 15+ years of NEET PYQs, and weekly grand mock tests.
- JEE Main & JEE Advanced Coaching: Advanced problem solving, multi-concept mechanics and electromagnetism integration, analytical modeling.
- Assam CEE Coaching: High-speed syllabus revision, previous year Assam CEE paper drills, state-level entrance mock exams.
- NDA Physics & General Ability: High-accuracy foundational physics for defense entrance.
